vocab.title: Vocabulary
vocab.subtitle: Learn new words every day, save them to your wordbook, and test yourself with a quiz.

daily.noKeyTitle: Add your Gemini API Key in Settings
daily.noKeyDesc: Add a key and get 3 new words every day with Bangla meanings, examples and pronunciation — completely free.

wordbook.addWordAria: Open or close the add-word panel
wordbook.lookupPlaceholder: Type an English word — e.g. reliable
wordbook.notEnglish: “{word}” doesn’t look like an English word — check the spelling and try again.
wordbook.searchPlaceholder: Search by word or Bangla meaning…
wordbook.emptyDesc: Tap ⭐ on a daily word to save it, or add your favourite words with “Add your own word”.

quiz.needMoreDesc: You need at least 3 saved words to play. Your wordbook currently has {n}.
quiz.generatingDesc: We’re creating 6 questions from your words — this may take a few seconds.
quiz.makeError: Couldn’t build the quiz — please try again in a moment.
quiz.startDesc: 6 questions will be generated from {n} of your wordbook words. Each question has 4 options — pick the correct one and see the explanation instantly.
quiz.msgGreat: Outstanding! Your vocabulary is getting really strong 🎉
quiz.msgGood: Well done! A little more practice and you’ll be perfect 👏
quiz.msgKeep: No worries — revise the words and try again. Practice is how we learn 💪
quiz.retryNote: The next quiz brings fresh questions from the same words.
